doc: Removes mouse support (FlxG.mouse). Without it, flixel defines FLX_MOUSE.
Removes middle and right mouse button events. Without it (and outside Flash < 11.2), flixel defines FLX_MOUSE_ADVANCED.
Disables native mouse cursors on Flash 10.2+. Without it, flixel defines FLX_NATIVE_CURSOR there.
Removes touch support (FlxG.touches). Without it, flixel defines FLX_TOUCH.
Removes keyboard support (FlxG.keys). Without it, flixel defines FLX_KEYBOARD.
Removes gamepad support (FlxG.gamepads). Without it, flixel defines FLX_GAMEPAD.
Removes flixel's sound system (FlxG.sound). Also disables the sound tray and pitch control. Without it, flixel defines FLX_SOUND_SYSTEM.
Removes the volume sound tray. Without it (and with the sound system), flixel defines FLX_SOUND_TRAY.
Removes the screen shown when the game loses focus. Without it, flixel defines FLX_FOCUS_LOST_SCREEN.
Removes the debugger and debug drawing. Without it, flixel defines FLX_DEBUG (which also defines FLX_TRACK_GRAPHICS).
Removes FlxObject.health.
Enables FlxObject.health. Flixel defines it automatically when neither FLX_HEALTH nor FLX_NO_HEALTH is set.
Enables flixel's replay recording support.
Additional rendering define.
Uses flixel 4.0 legacy collision.
Simplifies FlxPoint by not pooling instances, which can increase GC frequency. Without it, flixel defines FLX_POINT_POOL.
Disables sound pitch control. Defined automatically on Flash and with FLX_NO_SOUND_SYSTEM; otherwise flixel defines FLX_PITCH.
Removes FlxG.save. Without it, flixel defines FLX_SAVE.
Adds trackers to FlxPool instances. Only allowed in debug builds.
Adds `creationInfo` to FlxGraphic instances. Defined automatically with FLX_DEBUG.

Loads assets from the given relative or absolute directory instead of the build's assets. Unlike other flags, it takes a path. Sys targets only. When assets come entirely from outside the build directory, consider disabling <assets> tags in Project.xml to save memory.
Allows sound paths without an extension: the target's default type is used (ogg everywhere except Flash, which uses mp3). Set it to a string to use that extension instead.
Makes the debugger windows bigger.
